newsitem.title: USA: Goodrich tests Lake Raccourci well.
newsitem.headline: Goodrich tests Lake Raccourci well.

text.p: Goodrich Petroleum Corp said Friday it had completed testing of the State Lease 14589 No. 2 well at the Lake Raccourci Field in Lafourche Parish, Louisiana.

The well tested at a rate of 2.0 million cubic feet of gas, 24 barrels of oil and zero barrels of water per day on a 9/64-inch choke with a flowing tubing pressure of 5,076 pounds per square inch, the company said in a statement.
Goodrich, which has a 21 percent interest in the well and is the operator, said this is the second well drilled on some 3,500 acres of the field it has rights for.
